proposed_rules.trigger: A single-competitor 'X vs Knack' page's comparison content renders as two separate stacked sections instead of one side-by-side two-column table.
proposed_rules.decision: Reassemble as ONE two-column comparison-table block (competitor column + Knack column matched by shared category labels) rather than two unrelated blocks.
proposed_rules.rationale: The tree captures responsive stacking of one logical comparison table at the minWidth viewport.

provenance.evidence: C188 rc2c4 (Specode column) vs rc2c5 (Knack column), same category labels in both

proposed_rules.trigger: A [region] node (FAQ/accordion answer text) appears as a top-level sibling of the page's main containers rather than nested inside its corresponding accordion question row, duplicating/continuing content from an accordion elsewhere in the tree.
proposed_rules.decision: Do not treat as separate top-level content. Re-attach the region's text to the matching accordion row as its answer during Phase 2 reconciliation; never emit it as its own section or block.
proposed_rules.rationale: The capture promotes absolutely-positioned accordion answer panels (used for expand/collapse animation) out of their DOM parent, scattering answer text as stray top-level regions.

provenance.evidence: C188 rc4 [region] 'Knack. Knack's platform is des...' sibling of rc3 footer, duplicating an FAQ answer from rc2c9 accordion

proposed_rules.trigger: A full-width zone (~453px) immediately after the main content on every page, containing a fixed tagline ('The best no-code platform for...') and a divider/link row ('| |').
proposed_rules.decision: Treat as global site footer chrome; exclude from page inventory; model once as a site-wide fragment.
proposed_rules.rationale: Identical text/position recurs verbatim across every captured page.

provenance.evidence: C188 rc3c1c1 'The best no-code platform for...'

notes: Same comparison-page pattern as C187, plus a stray promoted FAQ-answer region (rc4) that escaped its accordion parent to become a top-level sibling.
